title: Divide every element, rounding down
description: Return a new list in which every element of xs is divided by d and rounded down toward negative infinity (so -7 divided by 2 gives -4, and 7 divided by -2 also gives -4). The order is kept; an empty list gives an empty list. d is never 0 and may be negative.
notes: Experiment int_division: hidden tests use negative operands; the description states floor semantics (round toward negative infinity) in words. The ref.zehn is written with int.div_floor / int.div_trunc / int.rem_euclid so it is valid under int_ops=operators and int_ops=explicit.
